newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Segye shrs jump on land development talk.
newsitem.headline: Segye shrs jump on land development talk.

text.p: Shares in South Korea's Segye Corp jumped 7.95 percent to this year's highest level of 9,910 won per share in Friday morning on talks that it had finalised a plan to develope a huge tract of its land, brokers said.
A Segye Corp official denied the talk.
The stock ranked second in the morning's list of most actively traded shares, with 741,680 shares changing hands.
The company official said it was studying various ways to develop the land located in the suburbs of the capital but nothing had yet been finalised.
LG Securities broker Koh Soon-shik said investors hoped development of the land, at present almost unused, would greatly contribute to increasing Segye's profits in the future.
